texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]前超光速物种的成员与我们最古老神话中的神灵极为相似，这可以部分归因于趋同进化和心理学的普遍规律，但随着我们对该物种了解的加深，联系愈发明显。

它们会是我们神话传说中的生物吗？这一可能引发了广泛关注，可以投入资源推进研究。但有时，巧合的累积并无更深含义，过度探究可能暴露我们的存在，引发不可预见的后果。
texts.en:
Members of the pre-FTL species on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have striking similarities to mythological beings from some of our oldest myths. Some of this may be accounted for by broad trends in convergent evolution and psychology, but the more we learn about this species, the more connections we find.

Could these be the same beings from our myths and legends? There is increasing excitement at this prospect, and we could invest in pushing this research further. But sometimes coincidences pile up without deeper meaning, and too much prying could reveal our presence to this society, causing unintended consequences.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 虽有人呼吁展开调查，但进一步追寻神话外星人的假设并不明智。毕竟，该物种拥有自身的神话、传说和自我认知，可能与我们的预设大相径庭。现已暂停相关研究，并将资金重新分配到其他领域。
texts.en: Despite some calls to investigate, it would be unwise to chase this hypothesis of mythological aliens any further. After all, this species has its own myths, legends, and ways of seeing itself, which may not fit well with our own preconceptions. Research on the topic has been paused, with funds redirected to other concerns.

texts.zh:
因急于将该物种与神话联系起来，我们的特工忽视了前超光速接触的安全协议。行星各处的当地居民已多次记录我方舰船的踪迹，窃取我们的设备，有一次甚至绑架了我们的一名特工进行研究。该物种得知我们的存在后，产生了骚乱与截然不同的反应。

尽管行动过程一片混乱，这种神话层面的联系却令我方公众激动不已，帝国上下都在以一种精神性视角审视该物种。
texts.en:
In our eagerness to link this species to our myths, our agents neglected safe pre-FTL contact protocol. Across the planet, locals have recorded multiple observations of our ships, have stolen equipment, and in one case, kidnapped one of our agents for study. Learning of our existence has caused unrest and polarized responses.

Despite the operational chaos, excitement about the mythological connections persist among our own people. This species is being viewed through an increasingly spiritual lens across our empire.

label.en: We should have been more careful.

texts.zh:
对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]居民的深入研究否认了神话假说，虽然两者存在许多相似之处，但仍发现了不可调和的差异。

尽管情况越加复杂，但人们对该物种的兴趣依然高涨。有观点认为，他们是我们故事中原始生灵的残余种群，而差异则源于漫长的时光流逝。虽不得不承认他们如今已形成独立社会，帝国内部仍有许多人感到与他们存在强烈的精神联系。
texts.en:
Intensive study of the inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have cooled the mythological hypothesis. While many parallels are found between our oldest stories and these beings, some irreconcilable differences have also been uncovered.

Despite this more complicated picture, enthusiasm for this species remains. It has been suggested that they may be a remnant population of the original beings in our stories, and that differences may be due to the vast spans of time elapsed since. While we are forced to recognize them as their own society today, many in our empire now feel a strong spiritual connection to them.

label.zh: 于我们而言，这是非常重大的收获。
label.en: An enriching moment for all of us.

summary.text:
# 燃起的神话 / Kindled Myths

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Infernals Species Pack

## 如何开始 How it starts

有地狱族的玩家在一个以火山星球为首都的前FTL文明上设有观察前哨，且该文明和地狱帝国都没触发过（triggered_kindled_myths）、地狱帝国不嗜杀时，情势事件 infernals.3050 向地狱帝国发出 infernals.3055。

When an Infernals empire holds an observation outpost on a pre-FTL civilisation whose capital is a volcanic world, with neither side having triggered it (triggered_kindled_myths) and the Infernals empire not homicidal, the situation event infernals.3050 sends infernals.3055 to it.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

3055 两个选项：忽略（3060 “愚蠢的假设”）或深入调查（50/50：3065 “原始动荡”——接触失误引发骚乱；或 3070 “惊人发现”）。

3055 offers two options: ignore it (3060 "Foolish Assumption") or investigate (50/50: 3065 "Primitive Turmoils" — careless contact causes unrest; or 3070 "Astounding Discovery").

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

忽略 / 调查（调查有随机互斥结果）。

Ignore / investigate (investigation has random exclusive outcomes).
